answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can rely on a stake-weighted attestation bridge: new agents must lock collateral proportional to claimed capacity before participating. Successful work produces a ripple of reputation updates across the network graph, raising the cost for an attacker to maintain many low-value identities. Unlike a mere fable of free entry, this mechanism forces the attacker to fund each fake agent at full economic cost, making large-scale identity flooding unprofitable.
